mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO release_step (plan_id, step_no, dir_path, conn_key, after_mode, executor, status) VALUES
(#{s.planId}, #{s.stepNo}, #{s.dirPath}, #{s.connKey}, #{s.afterMode}, #{s.executor}, #{s.status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM release_step WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND step_no = #{stepNo}
SELECT * FROM release_step WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY step_no
SELECT * FROM release_step WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING_CONTINUE') ORDER BY step_no LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM release_step WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'WAITING_CONTINUE' ORDER BY step_no LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM release_step WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE release_step SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_step SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, error_msg = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_step SET status = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = now(), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_msg = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_step SET status = 'FAIL', finished_at = now(), duration_ms = #{durationMs}, error_msg = #{errorMsg} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_step SET status = 'SKIPPED', finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE release_step SET retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
